name: @stewardmd/capacitor-whisper
description: On-device Whisper (whisper.cpp) speech-to-text for MaiK Scribe 'Clinical Dictation'. Audio never leaves the device — only recognized text is returned. Fully offline after a one-time model download.
author: StewardMD
_vendored: StewardMD-authored local plugin (SPM on iOS like capacitor-vision-ocr; NDK/JNI on Android). Links whisper.cpp v1.9.1 (MIT, git submodule at android/src/main/cpp/whisper-cpp). No JS dist — accessed via Capacitor.Plugins.Whisper.
